x: Vincent won both sprints for the home club, with Jock McKay running him close on each occasion.

Jock McKay showed a welcome return to form in gaining a place. The 1320 Yards saw Tommy Scrimshaw on the scratch mark and although considered a non-starter he raked together some togs and astounded us all by nearly catching his field on the first lap.

The second Inter-Club contest was held at Epsom on June 21st, and, as is usual in these away fixtures, our sprinters were lacking in numbers and we had to call on Jock McKay, who had turned up to witness the meeting.
Amongst his colleagues were other legendary names such as Oscar Horwood, Harry Parker, Bob Ricketts, Frank Thomson, Jock McKay and Wally Bayliss.
